title: Research construction: save 137 R420 cleanup XORs with exact four-wire synthesis
head: 47ebba87e064cc69d9b4834081fc74080762a74f
body:
## Finite bit-supplier construction — no new κ

Replace 101 disjoint windows of the selected #543 R420 cleanup with exact shortest XOR circuits on the same at-most-four registers. Cleanup costs **2,973 → 2,836 XORs**; the complete local word costs **26,916 → 26,779 native ADDs**. All 660 register frame paths, 420 dirty helpers, nine copies/erasures and the paid rank histogram remain unchanged. The native forward prefix decreases 144,651 → 109,173; reverse remains 2,270,064; the local payload envelope decreases 100 → 99 bits.

### Reproduce

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r420-four-wire-cleanup/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R420_FOUR_WIRE_CLEANUP: 101 windows, 137 XORs saved; 26916 -> 26779 native ADDs; 8 negative controls rejected`.

Python 3.11+, standard library only. `--out /path/to/new-directory` retains both complete words and their original-exporter records. The package includes source pins, all replacement circuits, proof and deterministic receipts. The optional `native.py` command recompiles the unchanged C++ checkers.

### Evidence and precise scope

- Fresh OS seed **17**, bit track; base **66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60**. Selected #543 source: **2065fe4f72a914d907f1046603f5a36f17018535**.
- Exhaust all **7,693** original contiguous windows on ≤4 registers; **284** admit shorter circuits. Independent row/column implementations and start/end-time interval schedules agree that **137 is optimal within the disjoint-original-window model**. No global circuit-optimality claim.
- Check complete GL(2–4,2) state sets and 242,940 directed distance-potential edges; all 1,408 local Boolean inputs and 756 positive-transfer columns pass. Every chosen rewrite has a nonincreasing positive transfer matrix in both orders.
- All 660 arbitrary-input columns restore, including dirty helpers. Fresh native legality plus 5/9/11-stage checks pass on both words (900/1,380/1,620 columns, **96 rejected bridge-omission controls**). A relocated minimal source tree reproduces both commands.
- Eight mathematical/accounting mutation controls, source-corruption/incomplete-certificate/output-preservation controls, Python 3.11/3.14, Ruff, whitespace and `make selected-record-check` pass.

Literal cleanup reversal H4 intentionally fails; the proof and verifier use the explicitly stated semantic H4′ (`C = U^-1` over F2 at the full frame), preserving the original guard. No global hosted program or outer assembly was regenerated. The selected conditional κ and `upstream/` are untouched; inherited all-size/compiler/common-label/mutable-basis/hosting/residual/precision/tape/analytic obligations remain. No full multiplication theorem, practical runtime result, remote CI or Lean pass is claimed.

### Credit and overlap

Credit eumemic's #543/#493, Dylan Crow's exporter/checker lineage and predecessor notices. Sagar Thakrar's #710 is the commuting-search/interface predecessor; its noncontiguous conjugations overlap two original gates, so no additive 139-XOR claim is made. #688, #742, new #748/#753 and updated #681 change different circuits; none is imported or assumed composable. This adds a complete finite synthesis class and independent certificates rather than another replay of their searches. There was no pinned coordination issue; the claim is recorded locally.

Prepared by **Jeffrey Cox (@namredips)** with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance**, including a separate column implementation and scoped review. Apache-2.0.
